stemMd: Why might year-round reserved study hours matter even with low occupancy?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They make meetings impossible at every time.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They ensure every student studies all day.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They preserve predictable access for students who occasionally need quiet.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They remove the need to publish schedules.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They prove empty rooms have no cost.

explanationMd: Students value assured availability, not just current use. Reserved hours preserve that assurance while allowing other uses at different times. Low occupancy does not by itself prove that predictable access lacks value.

distractorRationale.b: The proposal does not control every student’s behaviour.
distractorRationale.a: Meetings are allowed in published periods.
distractorRationale.e: The passage discusses balancing uses, not zero cost.
distractorRationale.d: Predictability and published periods remain important.
